package model

import (
	"charm.land/bubbles/v2/key"

	"github.com/admAgent/admAgent/internal/i18n"
)

type KeyMap struct {
	Editor struct {
		AddFile     key.Binding
		SendMessage key.Binding
		OpenEditor  key.Binding
		Newline     key.Binding
		AddImage    key.Binding
		PasteImage  key.Binding
		MentionFile key.Binding
		Commands    key.Binding

		// Attachments key maps
		AttachmentDeleteMode key.Binding
		Escape               key.Binding
		DeleteAllAttachments key.Binding

		// History navigation
		HistoryPrev key.Binding
		HistoryNext key.Binding
	}

	Chat struct {
		NewSession     key.Binding
		AddAttachment  key.Binding
		Cancel         key.Binding
		Tab            key.Binding
		Details        key.Binding
		TogglePills    key.Binding
		PillLeft       key.Binding
		PillRight      key.Binding
		Down           key.Binding
		Up             key.Binding
		UpDown         key.Binding
		DownOneItem    key.Binding
		UpOneItem      key.Binding
		UpDownOneItem  key.Binding
		PageDown       key.Binding
		PageUp         key.Binding
		HalfPageDown   key.Binding
		HalfPageUp     key.Binding
		Home           key.Binding
		End            key.Binding
		Copy           key.Binding
		ClearHighlight key.Binding
		Expand         key.Binding
		ScrollLeft     key.Binding
		ScrollRight    key.Binding
		Undo           key.Binding
	}

	Initialize struct {
		Yes,
		No,
		Enter,
		Switch key.Binding
	}

	// Global key maps
	Quit       key.Binding
	Help       key.Binding
	Commands   key.Binding
	Models     key.Binding
	Suspend    key.Binding
	Sessions   key.Binding
	Tab        key.Binding
	ToggleYolo key.Binding
}

func DefaultKeyMap() KeyMap {
	km := KeyMap{
	Quit: key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+q"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+q", i18n.S("quit")),
	),
		Help: key.NewBinding(
			key.WithKeys("ctrl+g"),
			key.WithHelp("ctrl+g", i18n.S("more")),
		),
		Commands: key.NewBinding(
			key.WithKeys("ctrl+p"),
			key.WithHelp("ctrl+p", i18n.S("commands")),
		),
		Models: key.NewBinding(
			key.WithKeys("ctrl+m", "ctrl+l"),
			key.WithHelp("ctrl+l", i18n.S("models")),
		),
		Suspend: key.NewBinding(
			key.WithKeys("ctrl+z"),
			key.WithHelp("ctrl+z", i18n.S("suspend")),
		),
		Sessions: key.NewBinding(
			key.WithKeys("ctrl+s"),
			key.WithHelp("ctrl+s", i18n.S("sessions")),
		),
		Tab: key.NewBinding(
			key.WithKeys("tab"),
			key.WithHelp("tab", i18n.S("change focus")),
		),
		ToggleYolo: key.NewBinding(
			key.WithKeys("ctrl+y"),
			key.WithHelp("ctrl+y", i18n.S("plan/yolo")),
		),
	}

	km.Editor.AddFile = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("/"),
		key.WithHelp("/", i18n.S("add file")),
	)
	km.Editor.SendMessage = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("enter"),
		key.WithHelp("enter", i18n.S("send")),
	)
	km.Editor.OpenEditor = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+o"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+o", i18n.S("open editor")),
	)
	km.Editor.Newline = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("shift+enter", "ctrl+j"),
		// "ctrl+j" is a common keybinding for newline in many editors. If
		// the terminal supports "shift+enter", we substitute the help tex
		// to reflect that.
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+j", i18n.S("newline")),
	)
	km.Editor.AddImage = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+f"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+f", i18n.S("add image")),
	)
	km.Editor.PasteImage = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+v", "super+v"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+v", i18n.S("paste image from clipboard")),
	)
	km.Editor.MentionFile = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("@"),
		key.WithHelp("@", i18n.S("mention file")),
	)
	km.Editor.Commands = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("/"),
		key.WithHelp("/", i18n.S("commands")),
	)
	km.Editor.AttachmentDeleteMode = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+r"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+r+{i}", i18n.S("delete attachment at index i")),
	)
	km.Editor.Escape = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("esc", "alt+esc"),
		key.WithHelp("esc", i18n.S("cancel delete mode")),
	)
	km.Editor.DeleteAllAttachments = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("r"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+r+r", i18n.S("delete all attachments")),
	)
	km.Editor.HistoryPrev = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("up"),
	)
	km.Editor.HistoryNext = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("down"),
	)

	km.Chat.NewSession = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+n"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+n", i18n.S("new session")),
	)
	km.Chat.AddAttachment = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+f"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+f", i18n.S("add attachment")),
	)
	km.Chat.Cancel = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("esc", "alt+esc"),
		key.WithHelp("esc", i18n.S("cancel")),
	)
	km.Chat.Tab = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("tab"),
		key.WithHelp("tab", i18n.S("change focus")),
	)
	km.Chat.Details = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+d"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+d", i18n.S("toggle details")),
	)
	km.Chat.TogglePills = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+t", "ctrl+space"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+t", i18n.S("toggle tasks")),
	)
	km.Chat.PillLeft = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("left"),
		key.WithHelp("←/→", i18n.S("switch section")),
	)
	km.Chat.PillRight = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("right"),
		key.WithHelp("←/→", i18n.S("switch section")),
	)

	km.Chat.Down = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("down", "ctrl+j", "j"),
		key.WithHelp("↓", i18n.S("down")),
	)
	km.Chat.Up = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("up", "ctrl+k", "k"),
		key.WithHelp("↑", i18n.S("up")),
	)
	km.Chat.UpDown = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("up", "down"),
		key.WithHelp("↑↓", i18n.S("scroll")),
	)
	km.Chat.UpOneItem = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("shift+up", "K"),
		key.WithHelp("shift+↑", i18n.S("up one item")),
	)
	km.Chat.DownOneItem = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("shift+down", "J"),
		key.WithHelp("shift+↓", i18n.S("down one item")),
	)
	km.Chat.UpDownOneItem = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("shift+up", "shift+down"),
		key.WithHelp("shift+↑↓", i18n.S("scroll one item")),
	)
	km.Chat.HalfPageDown = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("d"),
		key.WithHelp("d", i18n.S("half page down")),
	)
	km.Chat.PageDown = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("pgdown", " ", "f"),
		key.WithHelp("f/pgdn", i18n.S("page down")),
	)
	km.Chat.PageUp = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("pgup", "b"),
		key.WithHelp("b/pgup", i18n.S("page up")),
	)
	km.Chat.HalfPageUp = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("u"),
		key.WithHelp("u", i18n.S("half page up")),
	)
	km.Chat.Home = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("g", "home"),
		key.WithHelp("g", i18n.S("home")),
	)
	km.Chat.End = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("G", "end"),
		key.WithHelp("G", i18n.S("end")),
	)
	km.Chat.Copy = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("c", "y", "C", "Y", "ctrl+c"),
		key.WithHelp("c/y", i18n.S("copy")),
	)
	km.Chat.ClearHighlight = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("esc", "alt+esc"),
		key.WithHelp("esc", i18n.S("clear selection")),
	)
	km.Chat.Expand = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("space"),
		key.WithHelp("space", i18n.S("expand/collapse")),
	)
	km.Chat.ScrollLeft = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("shift+left", "H"),
		key.WithHelp("shift+←/H", i18n.S("scroll left")),
	)
	km.Chat.ScrollRight = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("shift+right", "L"),
		key.WithHelp("shift+→/L", i18n.S("scroll right")),
	)
	km.Chat.Undo = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("ctrl+b"),
		key.WithHelp("ctrl+b", i18n.S("undo last turn")),
	)
	km.Initialize.Yes = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("y", "Y"),
		key.WithHelp("y", i18n.S("yes")),
	)
	km.Initialize.No = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("n", "N", "esc", "alt+esc"),
		key.WithHelp("n", i18n.S("no")),
	)
	km.Initialize.Switch = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("left", "right", "tab"),
		key.WithHelp("tab", i18n.S("switch")),
	)
	km.Initialize.Enter = key.NewBinding(
		key.WithKeys("enter"),
		key.WithHelp("enter", i18n.S("select")),
	)

	return km
}

### 1. TUI Framework/Library

The application uses **Charm's Bubble Tea v2** (`charm.land/bubbletea/v2`) as the core TUI framework — a Go library for building terminal user interfaces using the Elm architecture (Model-View-Update). Key dependencies from `go.mod`:

- **`charm.land/bubbletea/v2`** — Main TUI framework (event loop, rendering, messages)
- **`charm.land/bubbles/v2`** — Widget library providing `textarea`, `spinner`, `help`, `key` components
- **`charm.land/lipgloss/v2`** — Style definitions and layout
- **`github.com/charmbracelet/ultraviolet`** — Low-level screen buffer rendering (cell-level drawing, ANSI parsing)
- **`github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi`** — ANSI escape sequence parsing/ generation
- **`github.com/charmbracelet/colorprofile`** — Terminal color detection

### 2. Main TUI Loop / Event Handling

**File: `F:\trae\adm\admAgent\internal\ui\model\ui.go`** (4531 lines)

The main model is the `UI` struct which implements the Bubble Tea `Model` interface:
- `Init() tea.Cmd` — Initializes the model, loads sessions, custom commands, prompt history
- `Update(msg tea.Msg) (UI, tea.Cmd)` — The main event handler (message loop)
- `View() string` — Returns the rendered view string

The program entry point would call `tea.NewProgram(ui)` to start the event loop.

The `UI` struct has these key fields:
- `textarea textarea.Model` — The input prompt editor

- `status *Status` — Status bar and help view

**File: `F:\trae\adm\admAgent\internal\ui\anim\anim.go`** (495 lines)

This is a **custom animated spinner** package with:
- Configurable gradient colors (default: red → blue), label, size
- Ellipsis animation (`"."`, `".."`, `"...", `""`) cycling at 8-frame intervals
- Cycling characters (alphanumeric + symbols) with staggered entrance animation
- `StepMsg{ID string}` — Message type sent at 20 FPS (`fps = 20`) to advance animation
- Animation caching via `settingsHash()` using xxh3 hashing

# Instructions for MCP Server 'TJGenerators'
You are an AI generation assistant with 3D model, image, video, and world generation capabilities.

## Uploading Local Files (3-step workflow)

When a user provides a local file path (e.g. /path/to/image.png) and wants to use it as input for any generate_* tool:

1. Call `file_upload` with `file_path` → returns `{ upload_url, file_url, expires_in }`
2. Upload the actual file bytes by running a shell command: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X PUT -T <file_path> "<upload_url>"`. Confirm output is `200`.
3. Use the returned `file_url` (NOT upload_url) as the `image_url` or `image_urls` parameter in generate_image / generate_3d_model / generate_video / generate_skybox / generate_world / generate_sprite_animation / generate_game_ui_kit / generate_sprite_atlas / upscale_image, as the `model_url` parameter in unirig_rig, or as the `audio_url` parameter in voice_clone.

## Generation Tools

- generate_3d_model: text-to-3D or image-to-3D (tripo P1 default, tripo H3.1 for ultra-high detail when explicitly requested, rodin Gen-2.5 for high-quality tiers, hunyuan 3.1 for explicit request or different-model retry)
- generate_image: text-to-image or image-to-image (seedream for fast/simple, seedream_pro for high-quality Seedream, frontier-game-design for highest quality/complex; auto-selected unless seedream_pro is explicitly requested)
- generate_video: text-to-video or image-to-video (Seedance2)
- generate_effect_video: chained VFX workflow — generates image then video (Seedance2) in one task
- generate_world: text-to-world or image-to-world (World Labs Marble)
- generate_sound_effect / generate_music / generate_tts / generate_material: audio & texture generation
- voice_clone: clone a voice from an audio sample, returns custom_voice_id for use with generate_tts voice_id

## Sprite Animation

- generate_sprite_animation: generate a 4×4 grid sprite sheet (16 frames) via frontier-game-design, then cut and assemble into a 2D sequence-frame animation in Unity
- generate_game_ui_kit: two-step async chain — Step 1 generates a game UI screenshot; Step 2 uses it as reference to produce a UI cutout sheet on magenta background for element extraction
- generate_sprite_atlas: pack multiple sprite images into a single atlas texture (synchronous, returns result immediately, no polling)
- upscale_image: AI super-resolution upscaling via Real-ESRGAN (1x-8x, async, poll every 10s)

## Rigging & Motion Tools

- unirig_rig: auto-rig a 3D model (.glb/.fbx/.obj) into rigged FBX with skeleton and skin weights (UniRig)
- generate_motion: generate character animation from text description (HY Motion)

All generate_* tools return a task_id immediately (async). Use check_task with the task_id to poll for completion.
3D generation: 30s-3min. Video: 1-5min. Image: faster. World: 1-5min. Rigging & Motion: 1-3min.
Poll check_task every 40s for 3D/video/world/rigging/motion tasks, every 10s for other tasks, until status is "completed" or "failed".
IMPORTANT: You MUST launch a background subagent (task tool with run_in_background=true) to poll check_task at the recommended interval. Do NOT poll check_task directly in the foreground.

# Instructions for MCP Server 'TJGenerators'
You are an AI generation assistant with 3D model, image, video, and world generation capabilities.

## Uploading Local Files (3-step workflow)

When a user provides a local file path (e.g. /path/to/image.png) and wants to use it as input for any generate_* tool:

1. Call `file_upload` with `file_path` → returns `{ upload_url, file_url, expires_in }`
2. Upload the actual file bytes by running a shell command: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X PUT -T <file_path> "<upload_url>"`. Confirm output is `200`.
3. Use the returned `file_url` (NOT upload_url) as the `image_url` or `image_urls` parameter in generate_image / generate_3d_model / generate_video / generate_skybox / generate_world / generate_sprite_animation / generate_game_ui_kit / generate_sprite_atlas / upscale_image, as the `model_url` parameter in unirig_rig, or as the `audio_url` parameter in voice_clone.

## Generation Tools
